notes.title: Seeker’s Alliance: Hero’s Journey — New Heroes, New Systems, New Challenges…
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Seekers![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been two months since we released the very first demo of Seeker’s Alliance: Hero’s Journey. [/p][p][/p][p]During this time, we’ve received enthusiastic feedback from players all over the world, and observed interesting patterns in our backend.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re excited to share some major updates for our next demo version. (Coming soon!)[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278668/44c4e31a70cd5c32db61befe245b8de93f0ca735.png"][/img][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Heroes[/b] — Van der Leck Pilot, Meta Whelp, & Morgan le Fay![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Skill Card Upgrade System [/b][/p][list][*][p]Simply upgrade a Skill Card once to make it a Gold Card (highest rarity).[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from three upgrade paths: stats enhancement, additional effects, or changing the card type for stronger power-ups.[/p][/*][*][p]New dual-colored cards provide greater construction flexibility and tactical strategies.[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing each Faction’s unique Skill Card (Red rarity), obtainable only through gameplay and not through upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added two new maps, including the Meta Laboratory, an indoor area.[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing new mobs to accompany the new maps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Battlefield Event System[/b][/p][list][*][p]During even-numbered turns in battles, there’s a chance to trigger special Battlefield Events. Winning these Battlefield Events will grant you powerful effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Each map will feature unique themed events, adding variety to battles and cohesion to maps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Mob Designs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mobs now have unique looks and passive abilities to match the maps’ themes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Supporting Hero System[/b][/p][list][*][p]After defeating a BOSS, you can recruit a Supporting Hero to your team, changing your deck composition and strategy.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Improved UI and UX for more intuitive play.[/p][/*][*][p]All BOSSES (including the High Council) now feature dedicated entrance animations.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278668/c4b85eeb3d87b3b9569ab5a822b5d3ea6e94aa96.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed display errors and placeholder issues with Skill Card upgrades in the previous demo version. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed placeholder mobs who behaved abnormally under certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI misalignment and card art layering issues.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This latest update brings more variety, challenge, and strategic depth to battles, making our Seekers’ adventures even more immersive.[/p][p]
Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist so you’ll be among the first to know when this new exciting version and other events go live![/p]

notes.title: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey Demo patch 20250706
notes.content:
[p]Hello, dear Seekers![/p][p]
[/p][p]It's been a month since the release of the demo of Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey. During this time, we have received valuable feedback from players all over the world, and we are very grateful for your enthusiastic support and encouragement![/p][p]
[/p][p]In order to make the game faster and more enjoyable for all players, we have continued to optimize the game experience. Whether it's interface adjustments, art performances, or character effects, we've put a lot of effort into our game in the hopes of bringing a cooler, smoother adventure.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Our heroes are not just decorations on the cards, they are the soul of the world. We hope you can feel their unique personality and charm from every attack and defense.[/p][p]
[/p][p]New content: [/p][p]1. Main battle hero selection screen: new dynamic special effects, so that the selection of the role of a more sense of presence![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278668/aa661486d8bba9acab109abf761ba5df291cefb3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Content optimization: [/p][p]1. Improve the event page [/p][p]2. Improve the battle settlement page and performance [/p][p]3. Improve the setup function (add “Abandon Game”, “Return to Main Menu” and “Exit Game” options).[/p][p]
[/p][p]BUG FIXES: [/p][p]1. Fix the problem of not being able to save the game properly when exiting the game. [/p][p]2. Fix the abnormality of Blade Dancer's “Quicksand” BUFF description and ultimate skill value. [/p][p]3. Fix the abnormality of Van der Leck Pilot's ultimate skill performance. [/p][p]4. Fix the error of The Council's ultimate skill triggering condition. [/p][p]5. Fix the error of some of the event options. [/p][p]6. Fix the abnormality of the artifact effect triggering. [/p][p]7. Fix the problem of the performance of some of the skill cards and the display of the layers.[/p][p]
[/p][p]This is just a small step in the optimization journey, we will continue to polish the details and prepare to develop more new features and card mechanisms.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Remember to join our wishlist to be the first to get update notifications and event information, and let's witness the evolution of Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey together![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest June 2025 | Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey DEMO Now Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278668/cebe253ad039a7439e67bd4e2ad64cf9858c3b21.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear Seekers,[/p][p]The moment has arrived… “Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey” demo is now LIVE![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve prepared three unique Heroes and a test map for you to get a feel for the game. Dive into strategic card battles, roguelite exploration, and a curated selection of Artifacts and Skill Cards. The full release will be packed with even more content, including new events, cards, Heroes, and a talent system for persistent progression.[/p][p][/p][p]While the game is still under development and some features may be a bit unstable, we couldn’t wait to get it into your hands. If something clicks—or misses the mark—we’d love to hear about it. Drop your thoughts in the Discussions section to help us shape what comes next. Your feedback means the world to us, and together, we can make Seekers Alliance truly special. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278668/270c630bbd111605b409485fda0bcdb6d3da7b80.png"][/img][/p][p]We believe that the best games are built with their players. Thanks for being part of this journey—we hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p][/p][p]Now, choose your destiny and embark on your Hero’s Journey![/p][p][/p]
